digest.component_or_area: completion banking oracle and observer (test infrastructure)
propositions: The banking observer currently filters writes by source=="tool" and misses policy fallback snapshots, causing the 0707 eval to fail despite system-level boundedness being maintained.
Post-commit e1352535ace, the model's genuine banking no longer interleaves on demand; the policy's per-criterion 3-response fallback snapshots are now the durability mechanism.
The oracle must be re-scoped to count durable bank writes regardless of actor (genuine model records AND fallback snapshots), excluding only seeded cache seeds, to reflect the actual system contract.
The ruled contract is system-level boundedness: all durable banks occur within bounded evidence-response gaps (max 3), regardless of whether they originate from the model or the policy fallback.
